---
applyTo: "_bibliography/**/*.bib"
---

# BibTeX bibliography

- Keep entries valid and consistently formatted.
- Put RL theory and bandit work in `_bibliography/rl-theory.bib`.
- Put interactive, imitation, and continual learning work in `_bibliography/interactive-learning.bib`.
- Prefer an `arxiv` field for arXiv links and retain the venue in `abbr` and `booktitle` or `journal`.
- Do not hand-code publication cards in the publications page.
